unit.description: Pure logic tests with no Obsidian runtime, filesystem, process, or provider boundary.

component.description: Tests that exercise plugin components with controlled adapters, job managers, or Obsidian shims.

contract.description: Tests for provider protocols, CLI command contracts, exported test surfaces, and architecture invariants.

e2e.description: Headless product-shell smoke using the built plugin package and a disposable Vault filesystem.

live.description: Opt-in check against a real local Vault plugin install. Does not launch Obsidian or call a provider.
